observations: The alpha channel contains every value from 0 through 255; it is a continuous lawn/soil selector, not a binary opacity card.
At decoded x=256, y=260 the selector is clean soil alpha 0.
The recovered wavy transition band spans approximately decoded y=260 through y=336 and reaches source lawn alpha near 1 while retaining white RGB modulation.
FieldGroundShader01 inverts source UV2 V before sampling the lawn/soil mask.
The transition contour moves from decoded y=289 through y=315 across x, so the source boundary itself supplies the organic edge and must not be sine-warped by the editor.
The canonical ledge is a bowed multi-band profile, not a vertical quad scaled to an arbitrary height.
Source UV0 advances at one repeat per 300 cm; cliff UV1 and border UV2 advance by approximately 0.516 and 0.511 per source metre respectively.
Generated outside corners continue the same profile through a quarter arc so adjacent faces do not leave triangular holes.

implementation_contract.canonical_surface_reconstruction: Each generated top tile samples at a 17 by 17 lattice. Untouched source-backed cells retain barycentrically reconstructed height, UV0, UV1, UV2, and Color0; authored cells use the recovered source-world scale rather than an inferred one-metre texture restart.
implementation_contract.lawn_uv_continuity: Every generated boundary vertex uses the canonical source triangle attributes at the same source-space position. This preserves the authored greenblend01_com phase, color field, mask UV, and mip derivatives where an edited cell meets untouched route geometry.
implementation_contract.lawn_surface_selection: Light Lawn and Dark Lawn each expose one project prefab. Source-backed cells reproduce the canonical surface samples exactly; newly filled cells use one continuous source-world field. There are no independent per-cell lawn variants.
implementation_contract.geometric_seam_control: Generated top surfaces use a 0.02 cm depth safety bias. This is enough to avoid coplanar flicker without exposing the dark vertical seam produced by the previous 0.5 cm lift.
implementation_contract.authored_ground_scale: Authored flat cells and directional ramps use one world-continuous UV0/UV1 field at the measured 300 cm source repeat. The ramp slope changes height and normals without rotating or restarting the texture island.
implementation_contract.dirt_transition_sampling: Subdivided dirt tiles sample the recovered glassmask01_com transition band rather than a generated square alpha texture. UV2 advances linearly at the recovered source carrier rate, preserving the actual mask contour without the previous inferred sine distortion.
implementation_contract.automatic_connectivity: The single Dirt Path prefab derives NESW links from same-height neighboring authored dirt cells. Edge, corner, straight, junction, isolated, and full configurations are implementation results rather than palette entries.
implementation_contract.legacy_compatibility: Previously saved lawn_a through lawn_d and path_0 through path_15 values remain accepted by the reader, then normalize to auto in memory and on the next save.
implementation_contract.profiled_ledges: Every exposed authored height boundary builds the decoded four-band FieldCliffShader01 profile at each 50 cm tier, preserves the source UV roles, and fills equal-height outside corners with a profiled quarter arc.
implementation_contract.local_fragment_cleanup: Ground overlay and foliage-card triangles are removed when any carrier vertex touches a cleanup cell; large canonical terrain groups retain conservative centroid masking. This removes local floating slivers without globally suppressing route layers.
implementation_contract.editor_platform_tools: Rebuild Selected Surface Blends reauthors cells without changing their shape, level, or surface. Raise as Flat Platform and Lower as Flat Platform operate on a selected footprint, normalize its cells to flat tops, and derive ledge faces and corners from neighbor height differences. Directional ramp prefabs remain the explicit connector between levels.
implementation_contract.persistence: New terrain edits emit visual_variant=auto. The field remains in the authored-scene schema only for backward compatibility and is not exposed as a Route 1 authoring choice.

claim_boundary: LGPE stores continuous route-authored ground paint rather than a reusable 1 m tile atlas. The modular tile topology is an editor/runtime reconstruction that reuses the exact recovered material, UV semantics, and source transition signal; it is not claimed to be an original Game Freak tile index table.
